description: This is a Python module implementing a Data Access Object (DAO) for notes storage using SQLite. It manages database configuration, connections, and CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) for notes entities. The code emphasizes runtime database path configuration, connection management, and note data serialization.

classes.name: _DBConfig
classes.description: Internal immutable data class holding the database path configuration.

methods.name: str _utc_now_iso()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp as an ISO-formatted string.

methods.name: str _parse_db_path_from_db_connection_txt(contents: str)
methods.description: Extracts the database file path from the content of db_connection.txt.

methods.name: _DBConfig _load_db_config()
methods.description: Loads the database configuration by reading the external db_connection.txt file at runtime.

methods.name: _get_conn()
methods.description: Provides a SQLite connection with proper configuration, encapsulating setup and cleanup.

methods.name: dict _row_to_note_dict(row: sqlite3.Row)
methods.description: Converts a sqlite3.Row object into a serializable note dictionary.

methods.name: List[dict] list_notes()
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by their last update timestamp in descending order.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single note by ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: dict create_note(title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note with a title and content, returning the stored record.

methods.name: Optional[dict] update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note, returning the updated record or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning True if deletion was successful.

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str]) -> Optional[dict]:$/
